front.title: Scan to get started
front.instruction: Use your phone camera. Enter your work email, then create an account or sign in with that exact address.
front.privacy: The QR code identifies this facility only. It contains no employee name, email, password, or permission.

back.title: Your Inspection-Trac quick start
back.safety: If the facility shown after scanning is not correct, stop and contact support. No assignment is created until your verified sign-in completes.

steps.title: Install Inspection-Trac
steps.detail: Use the iPhone or Android installation link on the registration page or in this guide.

steps.title: Create or access your account
steps.detail: Enter the email that should receive access, then sign up or sign in securely through Auth0.

steps.title: Confirm your assigned facility
steps.detail: Inspection-Trac verifies the signed-in email and assigns only this facility and its approved base role.

steps.title: Start your first inspection
steps.detail: Open Inspection-Trac and sign in with the same account. Your current facility access loads during sign-in.

steps.title: Get support
steps.detail: Use the support contact below and include the displayed support reference if your access needs attention.
